findings.finding: PR #780 (BasicNoiseSuppressorV1) and PR #795 (VirtualMicDspV1) added upper-only 2 dB reopen hysteresis with regression tests, but SPEC-0003 still described both gates without the hysteresis contract.
findings.resolution: SPEC-0003 now documents the hysteresis boundary for both gates: close at configured threshold, reopen only when the envelope reaches threshold +2 dB, hold state between.

changes.summary: Record upper-only 2 dB hysteresis for BasicNoiseSuppressorV1 and the optional VirtualMicDspV1 noise gate, including the anti-chatter rationale.
